Lightning Talk: Poor Man’s Autocomplete for Template Arguments - Max Sagebaum - CppCon 2025
---

Usually the auto complete feature of IDEs does not work for template types. With a little bit of macro magic or template metaprogramming it is possible to define default interfaces for template arguments that can be used for the auto completion. This technique is agnostic to the IDE and the Cpp standard.

I mainly work on implementing and applying algorithmic differentiation (AD) tools. CoDiPack is the AD library I have been developing for 10 years now. It makes heavy use of template metaprogramming. This all in the context of HPC applications.
